title: Demat 2.0 will bring instant bond settlement closer, trading after regulation and market readiness: NSDL MD

title: BlackRock private credit fund sees redemption pressure ease in third quarter
summary: BlackRock's flagship private credit fund saw lower redemption requests in the third quarter, signalling that pressure in the sector may be easing. Withdrawal requests at other BlackRock funds also declined, while analysts said improving sentiment and a clearing redemption backlog could support private credit firms and asset managers.

title: India-EU FTA: EU gets tariff quota for 1 lakh cars initially, rising to 1.6 lakh
summary: The India-EU free trade agreement will allow European automakers to export 1 lakh passenger vehicles annually at concessional duties initially, rising to 1.6 lakh from the 10th year. The pact also offers tariff concessions on electric vehicles, wines, pork, apples, kiwifruit, pears and peaches through quotas and price-based conditions.
